priorityList: Summon your pet and use Aspect of the Eagle if you are forced out of melee range.
Use Takedown (Coordinated Assault) along with your Trinkets and Racial buffs.
Use Kill Command if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear and any Howl of the Pack Leader buff (Wyvern, Boar, or Bear) is active.
Use Kill Command if Takedown is almost off cooldown and you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Use Takedown if you have at least 1 stack of Tip of the Spear (or 0 stacks if Twin Fangs is talented).
Use Wildfire Bomb if you are about to reach maximum charges to avoid capping.
Use Boomstick whenever Tip of the Spear is active.
Use Wildfire Bomb whenever Tip of the Spear is active.
Use Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if Tip of the Spear is active or to maintain the Raptor Swipe cleave buff.
Use Kill Command as a filler to generate Focus and Tip of the Spear stacks whenever Takedown is on cooldown.
Use Wildfire Bomb as a low-priority filler.
Use Takedown as a final filler if available.
